name: Bento Grid
oneLiner: A modular composition of unequal tiles, where layout itself is the argument and every card has one job.

effects.grid: 12 columns, 24px gutters, rows in multiples of 8px

motion.reducedMotion: cancel transforms; keep the elevation change as a border color shift

default.base: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; max-width: 1200px

position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-lg); min-height: 160px
display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px
default.label: font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)
default.icon: width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text)

default.base: font-family: 'Inter Tight', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2.75rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-weight: 600
default.delta: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--uiux-color-success)
default.caption: font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); line-height: 1.4; max-width: 34ch

default.base: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); text-decoration: none

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); color: var(--uiux-color-text)

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500

quiet.base: height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500

do: Build on a real 12-column grid; let tiles span 4, 6, 8, or 12 columns and one or two rows.
Give every tile exactly one message: a stat, a feature, a quote, or a single action.
Vary tile size deliberately so the composition has a spine, not a uniform checkerboard.
Keep tile padding constant (24px) and align all tile content to the same inner rhythm.
dont: Do not make all tiles the same size; that is a card grid, not a bento.
Do not put more than one primary action inside a tile.
Do not mix more than one accent gradient across the page.
Do not use 1px hairline borders and heavy shadows on the same tile.
antiPatterns: Nine identical square cards in a perfect 3×3 — no hierarchy, no bento.
Tiles with five text blocks and two buttons that read as tiny pages.
Grid gaps that differ between rows, breaking the visual rhythm of the modules.

notes: Read order follows DOM order; absolutely positioned tiles break keyboard and screen-reader order — do not use them.
Report changes in stat tiles with `aria-live="polite"` and explicit up/down wording, not color alone.
Tiles that are entirely clickable need a visible focus ring on the tile, not only on the inner link.
